description: The graph illustrates the loss evolution over iterations for various models during training, with the y-axis representing "Loss" on a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, and the x-axis representing "#Iteration" on a linear scale from 0 to 140,000. The plot includes five distinct lines, each corresponding to a different model configuration. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" model is represented by a blue line, which starts at a loss of approximately 3.35 and rapidly decreases to around 2.6 by 140,000 iterations. The "SepLLM (n=64)" model is shown with an orange line, starting at a loss of about 3.35 and decreasing to approximately 2.55. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" model is depicted by a green line, beginning at a loss of around 3.35 and declining to about 2.55. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" model is represented by a red line, starting at a loss of approximately 3.35 and decreasing to about 2.55. Finally, the "SepLLM (n=128)" model is shown with a dark blue line, starting at a loss of around 3.35 and decreasing to approximately 2.55. All models exhibit a rapid initial decrease in loss, followed by a slower convergence towards a stable value.
